WITH order_avg AS (
    SELECT
        l_orderkey,
        l_linenumber,
        l_extendedprice,
        AVG(l_extendedprice) OVER (PARTITION BY l_orderkey) AS order_avg_extendedprice
    FROM
        lineitem
)
SELECT
    l_orderkey,
    l_linenumber,
    l_extendedprice,
    order_avg_extendedprice
FROM
    order_avg
WHERE
    l_shipmode = 'AIR'
    AND l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01'
    AND l_shipdate <= '1997-12-31'
    AND l_extendedprice > order_avg_extendedprice
ORDER BY
    l_orderkey ASC,
    l_linenumber ASC

WITH supplier_quantities AS (
    SELECT
        n.n_name AS nation_name,
        s.s_name AS supplier_name,
        SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(l.l_quantity) DESC) AS supplier_rank
    FROM lineitem l
    JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
    JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    WHERE l.l_shipmode = 'TRUCK'
      AND l.l_shipdate >= '1998-01-01'
      AND l.l_shipdate <= '1998-12-31'
    GROUP BY n.n_name, s.s_name, s.s_suppkey
)
SELECT
    nation_name,
    supplier_name,
    total_quantity,
    supplier_rank
FROM supplier_quantities
WHERE supplier_rank <= 3
ORDER BY nation_name ASC, supplier_rank ASC
